units.Nehemiah 8:4: Esdras the scribe stood on a wooden platform. Beside him stood Mattathias, Samaias, Ananias, Ouria, Elkia and Maasaia on his right, and on his left Phadaias, Misael, Melchias, Osam, Asabdana, Zacharias and Mosollam.
units.Nehemiah 9:4: Jesus and the sons of Kadmiel, Sachania son of Sarabia, the sons of Chanani, stood on the Levites’ ascent and cried out with a loud voice to the Lord their God.
units.Nehemiah 12:30: The priests and Levites were purified, and they purified the people, the gatekeepers and the wall.
units.Nehemiah 13:24: and half their children spoke Azotian and did not know how to speak Judean.
units.Nehemiah 8:1: All the people gathered as one man in the open space before the Water Gate. They told Esdra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the Lord had commanded Israel.
units.Nehemiah 8:2: Esdras the priest brought the law before the assembly—men, women and everyone able to understand by listening—on the first day of the seventh month,
units.Nehemiah 8:3: and read from it from the hour when the sun gave light until midday, before the men and women, who were understanding; the ears of all the people were directed toward the book of the law.
units.Nehemiah 8:5: Esdras opened the book before all the people—for he was above the people—and when he opened it, all the people stood.
units.Nehemiah 8:6: Esdras blessed the Lord, the great God. All the people answered and said, “Amen,” lifting their hands, and they bowed and worshiped the Lord with their faces to the ground.
units.Nehemiah 8:7: Jesus, Banaias and Sarabia were helping the people understand the law, while the people remained in their places.
units.Nehemiah 8:8: They read from a book of God’s law, and Esdras taught and explained with knowledge of the Lord; the people understood the reading.
units.2 Chronicles 6:12: He stood before the Lord’s altar, opposite all Israel’s assembly, and spread out his hands.
units.2 Chronicles 6:13: For Solomon had made a bronze base and put it in the middle of the temple court, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high. He stood on it, fell on his knees opposite all Israel’s assembly, and spread out his hands toward heaven.
units.2 Chronicles 6:14: He said, “Lord, Israel’s God, there is no god like Thee in heaven or on earth, keeping covenant and mercy for Thy servants who walk before Thee with their whole heart.
units.Nehemiah 9:1: On the twenty-fourth day of this month, the sons of Israel assembled with fasting and in sackcloth.
units.Nehemiah 9:2: The sons of Israel separated themselves from every foreigner. They stood and confessed their sins and the lawless deeds of their fathers.
units.Nehemiah 9:3: They stood in their places and read from a book of the law of the Lord their God. They confessed to the Lord and worshiped the Lord their God.
units.Nehemiah 9:5: The Levites Jesus and Kadmiel said, “Stand up and bless the Lord your God from everlasting to everlasting. They will bless Thy glorious name and exalt it above all blessing and praise.”
units.Nehemiah 9:6: Esdras said, “Thou alone art the Lord. Thou madest heaven, the heaven of heaven and all their array, the earth and everything in it, the seas and everything in them. Thou givest life to all things, and the armies of heaven worship Thee.
units.2 Chronicles 20:14: The Spirit of the Lord came upon Oziel son of Zacharias, of the sons of Banaias, of the sons of Eleel, of Manthanias the Levite, from Asaph’s sons, in the assembly.
units.2 Chronicles 20:15: He said, “Listen, all Judah, inhabitants of Jerusalem, and King Jehoshaphat! Thus says the Lord to you yourselves: Do not fear or be terrified before this great crowd, because the battle array belongs to God, not to you.
units.2 Chronicles 20:16: Tomorrow go down against them. Behold, they are coming up by the ascent of Asas. You will find them at the edge of the river of the wilderness of Jeriel.
units.2 Chronicles 20:17: You will not have to wage war. Understand these things and see the Lord’s salvation with you, Judah and Jerusalem. Do not fear or be terrified about going out tomorrow to meet them, and the Lord will be with you.”
units.2 Chronicles 20:18: Jehoshaphat bowed on his face, and all Judah and Jerusalem’s inhabitants fell before the Lord to worship the Lord.
units.2 Chronicles 20:19: The Levites from the sons of Kaath and the sons of Kore stood up to praise the Lord, the God of Israel, with a loud voice raised high.
units.2 Chronicles 20:20: They rose early in the morning and went out to the wilderness of Thekoe. As they went out, Jehoshaphat stood, cried out, and said, “Hear me, Judah and Jerusalem’s inhabitants. Trust in the Lord your God, and you will be trusted. Trust in His prophet, and you will prosper.”
units.2 Chronicles 20:21: He consulted the people and appointed psalm singers and those giving praise, to give thanks and praise the holy things as they went out before the army. They said, “Give thanks to the Lord, for His mercy is for ever.”
units.2 Chronicles 20:22: When His praise of thanksgiving began, the Lord set the sons of Ammon to fight against Moab and Mount Seir, who had come out against Judah, and they were routed.
units.Nehemiah 12:27: At the dedication of Jerusalem’s wall, they sought the Levites in their places to bring them to Jerusalem, to celebrate the dedication and gladness with thodatha and songs, sounding cymbals, with psalteries and lyres.
units.Nehemiah 12:28: The sons of the singers gathered from the surrounding district to Jerusalem and from farmsteads,
units.Nehemiah 12:29: and from fields, for the singers had built farmsteads for themselves in Jerusalem.
units.Nehemiah 12:31: I brought the rulers of Jouda up onto the wall and stationed two great ones for praise. They went along to the right on top of the wall of refuse,
units.2 Chronicles 29:12: The Levites rose: Maath son of Amasi and Joel son of Azarias from Kaath’s sons; Kis son of Abdi and Azarias son of Jallelel from Merari’s sons; Joa son of Zemmath and Jodan son of Joacha from the sons of Gedsoni;
units.2 Chronicles 29:13: Sambri and Iiel from Elisaphan’s sons; Zacharias and Matthanias from Asaph’s sons;
units.2 Chronicles 29:14: Iiel and Semei from Heman’s sons; Samaias and Oziel from Jeduthun’s sons.
units.2 Chronicles 29:15: They gathered their brethren and purified themselves according to the king’s command, through the Lord’s ordinance, to cleanse the Lord’s house.
units.2 Chronicles 29:16: The priests went inside the Lord’s house to purify it. They cast out all the uncleanness found in the Lord’s house into the courtyard of the Lord’s house, and the Levites received it to cast it outside into the Kedron torrent.
units.2 Chronicles 29:17: They began purifying on the first day, the new moon of the first month. On the eighth day of the month they entered the Lord’s sanctuary. They purified the Lord’s house in eight days and finished on the sixteenth day of the first month.
units.2 Chronicles 29:18: They went inside to King Hezekiah and said, “We have purified everything in the Lord’s house: the altar of burnt offering and its articles, and the table of presentation and its articles.
units.2 Chronicles 29:19: All the articles King Ahaz defiled in his reign through his apostasy we have prepared and purified. Behold, they are before the Lord’s altar.”
units.Nehemiah 13:23: In those days I also saw Jews who had established households with Azotian, Ammanite and Moabite wives,
units.Nehemiah 13:25: I contended with them, cursed them, struck some of their men and pulled out their hair. I made them swear by God: “You shall not give your daughters to their sons or take any of their daughters for your sons.
units.Nehemiah 13:26: “Did not Salomon king of Israel sin in this way? Among many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved by God, and God made him king over all Israel. Yet foreign women turned even him aside.
units.Nehemiah 13:27: “Are we not to hear of you doing all this evil, breaking faith with our God by establishing households with foreign wives?”
units.2 Kings 18:17: The king of the Assyrians sent Tharthan, Raphis, and Rhapsakes from Lachish to King Hezekiah against Jerusalem with a great force. They went up, came to Jerusalem, and stood at the aqueduct of the upper pool, on the road of the Fuller’s Field.
units.2 Kings 18:18: They called to Hezekiah. Eliakim son of Chelkias the steward, Somnas the scribe, and Joash son of Asaph the recorder went out to him.
units.2 Kings 18:19: Rhapsakes said to them, ‘Tell Hezekiah: Thus says the great king, the king of the Assyrians: What is this confidence in which you trust?
units.2 Kings 18:20: You said—only words of lips!—“Counsel and strength for war.” Now then, in whom do you trust, that you have broken with me?
units.2 Kings 18:21: Now behold, you have put your trust in this broken reed staff, Egypt. If a man supports himself on it, it enters his hand and pierces it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust him.
units.2 Kings 18:22: Since you said to me, “We trust the Lord God,” is He not the One whose high places and altars Hezekiah removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, “Before this altar you shall bow down in Jerusalem”?
units.2 Kings 18:23: Now join yourselves to my master, the king of the Assyrians. I will give you two thousand horses if you can provide riders for them.
units.2 Kings 18:24: How can you turn back the face of one district governor, one of my master’s least servants? Yet you hope in Egypt for chariots and horsemen!
units.2 Kings 18:25: Now have we come up without the Lord against this place to destroy it? The Lord said to me, “Go up against this land and destroy it.”’
units.2 Kings 18:26: Eliakim son of Chelkias, Somnas, and Joash said to Rhapsakes, ‘Please speak to your servants in Syrian, for we understand it. Do not speak with us in Judean. Why are you speaking within the hearing of the people on the wall?’
units.2 Kings 18:27: Rhapsakes said to them, ‘Has my master sent me to speak these words to your master and to you? Was it not to the men sitting on the wall, who are to eat their own dung and drink their own urine together with you?’
units.2 Kings 18:28: Rhapsakes stood and cried out loudly in Judean: ‘Hear the words of the great king of the Assyrians!
units.2 Kings 18:29: Thus says the king: Do not let Hezekiah lift you up with words, for he cannot rescue you from my hand.
units.2 Kings 18:30: Do not let Hezekiah make you hope in the Lord by saying, “The Lord will surely rescue us; this city will certainly not be handed into the hand of the king of the Assyrians.”
